author: Steve
name: Clean Slices Feature
description: Adds a vertical slice to a Clean Slices solution: entity + errors + events (Core), EF configuration + event handlers (Infrastructure), CRUD endpoints (Api). Run from the solution root.

app.description: Root name of the solution the feature is added to (e.g. Acme.Orders).

plural.description: Plural form of the entity name, used for folders, namespaces, table and route (default: name + 's').

result.description: The solution uses the Result<T> pattern: the entity returns results and the endpoints compose them.

manualInstructions.text: Feature added. Create a migration for the new table: dotnet ef migrations add Add<Entity> --project src/<App>.Infrastructure
